title: Resume refusal overwrites the session preview and is not rolled back on commit failure (refuse_engram_queue_resume_locked)
outcome: Resume refusal overwrites the session preview and is not rolled back on commit failure (refuse_engram_queue_resume_locked)
acceptance: A Resume refusal on a retained, interrupted or begun head sets its own fixed refusal text, or leaves a preview that already starts with 'Engram' untouched, so unstarted_resume_step's 'Engram recovery retained this prompt: {preview} Reconcile …' message never embeds a second refusal sentence.
When the commit after stamp_session_at_index fails, the session's preview is restored to its previous value.
A unit test covers both behaviours.
